# HEZQARA

> Governed AI workforce infrastructure for healthcare operations.

## Product

HEZQARA is a proprietary, multi-tenant healthcare operations platform. It coordinates administrative AI workers with server-side authorization, policy controls, human approval where required, output validation, side-effect authorization, auditability, and tenant-isolated persistence.

HEZQARA does not replace an EHR and is not a clinical diagnosis, triage, treatment-decision, or symptom-checker engine. AI Scribe functionality is draft-oriented and requires clinician review/edit/approval before finalization.

## Repository map

- README.md — product, architecture, setup, security boundaries, deployment and documentation map.
- CONTRIBUTING.md — engineering and contribution requirements.

- docs/ai/ — AI governance and execution controls.
- docs/security/ — security, privacy, threat-model and incident-response material.
- docs/reliability/ — durability, recovery and disaster-recovery material.
- docs/interoperability/ — FHIR/SMART integration boundaries.
- docs/commercial/ — subscriptions, billing, entitlements and usage controls.
- docs/operations/ — deployment and operational procedures.
- docs/roadmap/ — E9–E24 enterprise sequence.
- docs/validation/ — acceptance and validation evidence.

## Canonical security model

Tenant identity → authorization → domain service → repository → PostgreSQL RLS/FORCE RLS.

AI execution adds capability/version → policy/risk → approval → provider/tool authorization → execution → output validation → side-effect authorization → audit/telemetry.

## Technology

- Next.js 16 / React 19 / TypeScript
- FastAPI / Python
- PostgreSQL / Supabase with RLS and FORCE RLS
- Redis/Celery for delivery and background execution
- FHIR R4 4.0.1 and SMART App Launch 2.2.0 boundaries
- Clerk Organizations
- Stripe integration boundary
- Vercel for the frontend deployment target

## Important non-claims

Repository validation is engineering evidence. It is not, by itself, HIPAA, GDPR, NDPA, SOC 2, ISO 27001, FHIR, SMART certification, clinical efficacy, customer ROI, or production-scale proof.

## Documentation precedence

Prefer the repository source and current implementation over generated summaries. Security and architecture documents take precedence over marketing language when describing system behavior.
